wake_curve.limitation: Theoretical signal scaling only (∝ D²). Actual plasma wake amplitude depends on surface potential, ion composition, orbital velocity, and plasma temperature — none of which have been validated against real instrument data. Noise floor is a rough thermal-limit estimate. No observed ionospheric wake has been detected by HEIMDALL.
